meta.name_zh: COVID-19疫苗接種與COVID-19確診、中重症及死亡資料檔
meta.data_description_zh:
說明：
1. NIIS 資料庫中戶政比對到之本國籍及非本國籍所有個案。
2. 上述接種資料為 COVID-19疫苗開打以來，接種個案的疫苗接種各劑別、廠牌及接種
日期資訊。
接種劑次排序及欄位資料定義說明：
(1) 依個案接種日期排序，不論廠牌、排除兩劑間隔不足21日之後一劑。
(2) 個案的基礎加強劑與追加劑之接種日期、廠牌、接種單位均相同，只列追加劑。
(3) Brand3僅為基礎加強劑。
(4) 提供Brand n 的n值為當次提供資料中之最大接種劑數。
範例: 撈取範圍之個案接種 CoV最大劑數達13劑，則提供 Brand 的最大劑次即為
Brand13。
3. 排除有接種基礎加強劑下，未達2劑基礎劑，或未接種追加劑之族群註。
（註:該排除族群限未曾接種 XBB相關疫苗。）
4. 排除已除口或NIIS 死亡日期在110/03/21(含)註以前的個案。
（註:即 COVID-19疫苗尚未實施之接種日期。）
meta.notes_zh: 表(二) H_CDC_COVID19_2：此檔最新年度僅至2022年，2023年度尚未提供。

meta.data_description_en:
Notes:
1. All cases, Taiwanese and non-Taiwanese, matched to household registration in the NIIS database.
2. The above vaccination data cover, since the start of COVID-19 vaccination, each dose, brand and vaccination
date of the vaccinated cases.
Explanation of dose ordering and field definitions:
(1) Ordered by the case's vaccination date, regardless of brand, excluding any later dose given less than 21 days after the previous dose.
(2) If a case's primary booster and additional dose have the same vaccination date, brand and vaccination site, only the additional dose is listed.
(3) Brand3 is only the primary booster.
(4) The n in the provided Brand n is the maximum number of doses in the data provided in the current extraction.
Example: if a case in the extraction range has a maximum of 13 CoV doses, the maximum dose provided for Brand is
Brand13.
3. Excludes the group who received a primary booster but fewer than 2 primary doses, or who did not receive an additional dose (note:
(Note: this excluded group is limited to those who have never received an XBB-related vaccine.)
4. Excludes cases whose household registration was removed or whose NIIS date of death is on or before 21 March 2021 (ROC 110/03/21) (inclusive)
(Note: i.e. the vaccination date before COVID-19 vaccination was implemented.)
meta.notes_en: Table (2) H_CDC_COVID19_2: the latest year available is 2022; 2023 has not yet been released.
